subject: Apply a cross-process film grade (E-6 slide film processed in C-41 chemistry): push greens and yellows in highlights aggressively, shift shadows toward deep cyan-blue, add strong contrast and color aberration in the midtones, slightly oversaturate the entire image with a chemical, unpredictable quality. Skin tones should look faintly greenish. High contrast with clipped highlights. Preserve subject identity and composition while giving the image an intentionally altered photochemical character.
